keep.body: No email moves. DeclutrMail saves your decision.

archive.lead: They leave Inbox and stay in Gmail’s All Mail.
archive.storage: Archived email still counts toward your Gmail storage.

later.lead: They wait in Gmail under the DeclutrMail/Later label, then come back to Inbox at the time you pick. Future email is unchanged.

unsub.lead: We’ll send a one-click unsubscribe request. Once it’s delivered, it can’t be recalled.
unsub.footer: Stopping future email is up to the sender. Email you already have stays where it is.
unsub.toastAccepted: {Sender} accepted the unsubscribe request. Stopping is up to them.
unsub.inline: We’ll send a one-click unsubscribe request. It can’t be recalled once delivered.
unsub.disabled: No unsubscribe link from this sender

unsubMailto.title: Unsubscribe from {Sender} by email?
unsubMailto.body: {Sender} takes unsubscribe requests by email. We’ll open a Gmail draft for you to send. Nothing is sent automatically.
unsubMailto.toast: Your draft is in Gmail. Send it from there.
unsubMailto.markSent: Marked the unsubscribe email to {Sender} as sent

delete.lead: They move to Gmail Trash. Future email is unchanged.
delete.footer: Undo from Activity for 30 days. Gmail keeps Trash for up to 30 days unless you empty it.

undo.failed: Couldn’t undo that. Try again from Activity.
undo.expired: This can’t be undone anymore. The 30-day window has closed.

meterRefund.one: 1 email added back to your free total
meterRefund.other: {n} emails added back to your free total

deleteAccount.title: Delete your DeclutrMail account?
deleteAccount.subtitle: Your email in Gmail stays as it is.

deleted.title: What gets deleted
list: Saved email details (senders, subjects, snippets, labels, dates)
Sender decisions, rules and Screener history

kept.title: What we keep
list: A minimal security record that the deletion happened, with no email content
Billing records stay with Paddle or Razorpay.

schedule.label: Schedule deletion for {deletionDate}
schedule.detail: In 7 days. You can cancel any time before then.
schedule.detailUndo: On {deletionDate}, when your last undo window closes (up to 30 days). Undo keeps working until then, and you can cancel any time.

now.label: Delete now
now.detail: Skips the 7-day wait and ends your open undo windows. Changes you could still undo become permanent. Deletion runs within minutes.

deleteAccount.emailNote: We’ll email you a confirmation with a cancel link.

pastDue.banner: Payment failed. Update your card by {deadline} to keep {planName}.

planEnds.pass: Your {passName} ends on {passEndDate}. Then you’re back on {freeName}.

firstBacklog.header: Your first review is done. These {k} senders hold {pct}% of your inbox. Start at the top.

brief.title: {BRIEF_NAME}
brief.pitch: A daily summary of yesterday’s email in DeclutrMail, ready at an hour you choose.
brief.disclosure: To write your {BRIEF_NAME}, DeclutrMail can send Anthropic the sender, subject line, and Gmail’s short preview snippet. It never sends the full contents of an email.

followups.title: Follow-ups
followups.pitch: Conversations where you sent the last email and haven’t heard back, oldest first.

pro.joinedSub: Nothing changes on your current plan.
pro.error: Couldn’t join the waitlist. Try again.

badge.proAriaJoined: {Feature}, coming with {proName}. You’re on the waitlist.

screener.pitch: Screener collects new senders for your review. Their email keeps arriving in Gmail until you decide.

count.one: 1 new sender has emailed you since you joined.
count.other: {n} new senders have emailed you since you joined.

screener.footnote: On {freeName}, every sender still shows in Senders, and you can move any of them to Later.

autopilot.intro: See what each rule would match in your Gmail right now. Previews don’t move anything.
autopilot.pitch: With {plusName}, Autopilot rules handle new email from senders you’ve already decided on. Watch first: nothing moves until you approve. Act now: email moves right away and as it arrives, without asking each time.
autopilot.undoNote: Moves made by a rule can be undone from Activity for 30 days. Unsubscribe requests can’t be recalled.
autopilot.quiet: Quiet hours set when rules may act.
autopilot.error: Couldn’t load your rules. Try again in a moment.

locked.passLink: Or try it for {passDays} days with the {passName}, {passPrice} once
locked.refund: {refundDays}-day money-back on any purchase, once per customer.

title.withBrief: Use AI for suggestion explanations and your {BRIEF_NAME}?

intro.all: DeclutrMail can use Anthropic, an AI company, to write a short explanation for each suggestion. Here’s exactly what it would send.
intro.withBrief: DeclutrMail can use Anthropic, an AI company, to write a short explanation for each suggestion and to write your {BRIEF_NAME}. Here’s exactly what each one would send.

explain.heading: Suggestion explanations
explain.sends: For each sender we explain, DeclutrMail sends the sender’s name and email domain, the suggested choice with the rule behind it and how sure it is, how much they email you and how much of it is marked read, and Gmail’s category for them (like Promotions). It never sends subject lines or preview snippets for this.

brief.heading: {BRIEF_NAME}
brief.sends: To write your {BRIEF_NAME}, DeclutrMail can send Anthropic the sender, subject line, and Gmail’s short preview snippet. It never sends the full contents of an email.

aiConsent.never: Anthropic never receives the full contents of an email, attachments or images.
aiConsent.noFetch: We never fetch or store full email contents.
aiConsent.who: Anthropic only uses what we send to write this text for you.
aiConsent.training: We don’t use your email to train AI models. Anthropic sets its own retention and training terms.

decline.all: If you choose Not now, you still get an explanation for each suggestion, written from our rules without AI.
decline.withBrief: If you choose Not now, you still get an explanation for each suggestion, written from our rules without AI, and a basic {BRIEF_NAME} written without AI.

aiConsent.change: You can change this any time in Settings → AI.

toast.all: AI explanations are on. New explanations will use it.
toast.withBrief: AI is on for explanations and your {BRIEF_NAME}. Your next {BRIEF_NAME} will use it.

toast.all: AI explanations are off. Explanations are now written from our rules.
toast.withBrief: AI is off. Explanations are written from our rules, and your next {BRIEF_NAME} uses the basic version.

missing.banner: Your {BRIEF_NAME} is the basic version. AI writing is off.

upgrade.title: Use AI for your {BRIEF_NAME} too?
upgrade.decline: If you choose Not now, your {BRIEF_NAME} is written without AI. AI explanations stay on.

aiConsent.reask: We’ve changed what DeclutrMail sends to Anthropic. Review it and choose again.

label.withBrief: Use AI for suggestion explanations and my {BRIEF_NAME}

help.all: Sends Anthropic each sender’s name and domain, the suggested choice and why, how much they email you, how much is marked read, and their Gmail category. Never subject lines, snippets or full emails. Off means explanations are written from our rules.
help.withBrief: For explanations, sends Anthropic each sender’s name and domain, the suggested choice and why, how much they email you, how much is marked read, and their Gmail category. For your {BRIEF_NAME}, sends the sender, subject line and preview snippet of each email it covers. Never full emails. Off means explanations from our rules and a basic {BRIEF_NAME}.

state.paused: Paused by DeclutrMail. Explanations are written from our rules for now.
state.review: Needs your review. Off until you choose again.

aiConsent.killSwitch: AI writing is paused for now. Your {BRIEF_NAME} uses the basic version.
aiConsent.error: Couldn’t save your choice. Try again.

explain.screener: New senders wait here until you decide on them. Their email keeps arriving in Gmail as usual.
explain.triage: Triage shows one sender at a time with a suggested choice. Anything that moves email shows a preview first.
explain.autopilot: Autopilot rules handle new email from senders you’ve already decided on. Turning one on shows a preview of what it would change first.
explain.autopilotLocked: Autopilot rules find matching email for you to approve. Rules that act on their own are part of {plusName}.
explain.quiet: During quiet hours, Autopilot waits, even for matches you approved. Anything you do yourself still happens right away.
explain.later: Later moves a sender’s email out of your inbox now and brings it back at the time you pick. Until then it waits in Gmail under the DeclutrMail/Later label.
explain.activity: Everything DeclutrMail changed in your Gmail.
explain.activityEmpty: Changes you or your Autopilot rules make will show up here.
explain.protected: DeclutrMail suggests Keep for these senders and leaves them out of bulk changes and Autopilot rules.
explain.backlogPass: One payment for {passDays} days of {plusName}, to clear older email. It doesn’t renew.

plainExplain.volumeLessThanOne: {name} sends less than one email a month.
plainExplain.readShare: {readPct}% of their email from the last 90 days is marked read.
plainExplain.noRecent: {name} hasn’t sent you anything in the last 90 days.

rule.protect_user_defined: You marked this sender as protected.
rule.protect_replied: Protected because you’ve written to this sender at least three times and they wrote back.
rule.protect_starred: Protected because you starred one of their emails this year.
rule.protect_gmail_important: Protected because Gmail marked at least three of their emails important this year.
rule.wrote_to_at_least_once: Suggested: Keep. You’ve written to them.
rule.gmail_primary: Suggested: Keep. Gmail puts them in your Primary inbox, and their email has no unsubscribe link.
rule.starred_recently: Suggested: Keep. You starred one of their emails this year.
rule.high_read_rate: Suggested: Keep. At least half their email from the last 90 days is marked read.
rule.long_relationship_engaged: Suggested: Keep. They’ve emailed you for 5 years or more, and at least 30% of their email from the last 90 days is marked read.
rule.insufficient_signal: Suggested: Later. There isn’t enough to go on yet.
rule.score_inconclusive: Suggested: Later. Their pattern is mixed, so there’s no clear choice yet.
rule.score_no_unsub_channel: Suggested: Later. Their email has no unsubscribe link.
rule.score_quiet_stream: Suggested: Later. They email too rarely to be worth unsubscribing from.

plainExplain.staleClaim: No email arrived from this sender in the last 90 days, so there’s nothing to measure as marked read yet.

aiPrompt.text: Want each explanation written in a sentence or two by AI? See what it would send first.
aiPrompt.frequency: At most once every 30 days, and never again after it’s been dismissed twice or the user has chosen on the card.
